scope: DM1 V1 contract-only regression gate for open chest G0426/G0425 and leader-hand survival across teleporter level changes

CHEST.C:F0333.claim: open chest selects G0426_T_OpenChest and materializes the first visible linked contents into G0425_aT_ChestSlots

CHEST.C:F0334.claim: close chest clears G0426_T_OpenChest and recompacts non-empty G0425_aT_ChestSlots into the container link chain

CHAMPION.C:F0297/F0298/F0300/F0301/F0302.claim: leader-hand put/remove, C30+ G0425 clear/write, and occupied-slot swap preserve distinct hand and chest-slot state

DUNGEON.C:F0163/F0173/F0174.claim: link append and current/party map setters do not clear G0425/G0426 or leader-hand state

MOVESENS.C:F0267.claim: teleporter target resolution can change the current map during movement without closing the currently open chest

OBJECT.C:F0033.claim: open materialization refreshes object icon identity without changing thing identity

BLITMASK.C:F0133.claim: masked blit routing is presentation-only and not a chest state mutation

DEFS.H.claim: C30, C10_COLOR_FLESH, G0425, and G0426 anchor the slot/global constants used by the gate

expectedRuntimeContract: Open on level A fills three G0425 slots and leaves the leader hand occupied.
Teleporting to level B and back to level A preserves G0426, the G0425 slots, chest link identity, and leader-hand weight.
Closing after returning to level A clears G0426 and rewrites three visible links in slot order.
Reopening level A rematerializes the same three items in the same order.
Closing while still on level B follows the foreign-map close-without-open guard and preserves G0426/G0425.
